findings.title: No decoupling cap found near U803
findings.description: U803 (PAM8302A) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U803 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U803 with short, wide traces to vias.
findings.summary: No decoupling cap found near U803

findings.title: No decoupling cap found near U801
findings.description: U801 (SN74LVC1G126) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U801 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U801 with short, wide traces to vias.
findings.summary: No decoupling cap found near U801

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J402
findings.description: Connector J402 (DYNAMIXEL_TTL_2) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J402. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J402

findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: U301 harmonics in 30-88 MHz band
findings.description: U301 (AP64350) switching at 0.5 MHz has 117 harmonics in the 30-88 MHz band (harmonics 60-176). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U301. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U301 harmonics in 30-88 MHz band

findings.title: U301 harmonics in 88-216 MHz band
findings.description: U301 (AP64350) switching at 0.5 MHz has 257 harmonics in the 88-216 MHz band (harmonics 176-432). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U301. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U301 harmonics in 88-216 MHz band

findings.title: U301 harmonics in 216-960 MHz band
findings.description: U301 (AP64350) switching at 0.5 MHz has 1489 harmonics in the 216-960 MHz band (harmonics 432-1920). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U301. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U301 harmonics in 216-960 MHz band

findings.title: U301 harmonic envelope
findings.description: U301 (AP64350) switching at 0.50 MHz, duty ≈50%. Harmonic envelope: flat to 0.3 MHz, -20 dB/dec to 32 MHz, -40 dB/dec above. Harmonics extend into FCC test range starting at 60th harmonic.
findings.recommendation: Minimize the hot loop area (input cap → high-side switch → inductor → low-side switch → input cap). Every halving of loop area reduces emissions by 6 dB.
findings.summary: U301 harmonic envelope

findings.title: differential diff pair changes layers
findings.description: Net SPK_P (part of differential diff pair) transitions across 2 layers (B.Cu, In2.Cu) with 2 via(s). Each layer transition is a potential DM-to-CM conversion point. Ensure stitching vias or decoupling caps at each transition.
findings.recommendation: Add ground stitching vias within 2× dielectric height of each signal via. Preferably route diff pairs on a single layer to avoid layer transitions entirely.
findings.summary: differential diff pair changes layers

findings.title: differential diff pair changes layers
findings.description: Net SPK_N (part of differential diff pair) transitions across 2 layers (B.Cu, In2.Cu) with 2 via(s). Each layer transition is a potential DM-to-CM conversion point. Ensure stitching vias or decoupling caps at each transition.
findings.recommendation: Add ground stitching vias within 2× dielectric height of each signal via. Preferably route diff pairs on a single layer to avoid layer transitions entirely.
findings.summary: differential diff pair changes layers

findings.title: differential diff pair on outer layer
findings.description: Net SPK_P (differential diff pair) is 59% routed on outer layers. Inner stripline layers provide better shielding and lower radiation for high-speed differential pairs.
findings.recommendation: Route differential pairs on inner stripline layers when possible for reduced EMI.
findings.summary: differential diff pair on outer layer

findings.title: Large hot loop for U301
findings.description: U301 (AP64350) hot loop area ≈ 46mm² (triangle: C303 → U301 → L301). Recommended: <25mm² for low EMI.
findings.recommendation: Place C303, U301, and L301 in a tight triangle. Minimize trace length between them. Input cap should be adjacent to the IC with the inductor on the opposite side.
findings.summary: Large hot loop for U301

top_issues.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J504. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
top_issues.summary: No EMC filtering near J504

top_issues.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: SPK_N
top_issues.description: Net SPK_N has 2 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, In2.Cu. 2 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
top_issues.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
top_issues.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: SPK_N

top_issues.title: differential diff pair changes layers
top_issues.description: Net SPK_P (part of differential diff pair) transitions across 2 layers (B.Cu, In2.Cu) with 2 via(s). Each layer transition is a potential DM-to-CM conversion point. Ensure stitching vias or decoupling caps at each transition.
top_issues.recommendation: Add ground stitching vias within 2× dielectric height of each signal via. Preferably route diff pairs on a single layer to avoid layer transitions entirely.
top_issues.summary: differential diff pair changes layers

top_issues.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.
